events.description: ENDORSED ORDER: Per the guidance issued by Secretary Scanlan (www.sos.nh.gov/elections/absentee-ballots), absentee voting for the 2026 State Primary Election is currently underway, and voters who intend to "rely on receiving and returning [an] absentee ballot by mail" are advised to "request [their] ballot[s] more than two weeks before election day". The parties shall address in their respective opposition and reply to the plaintiffs' motion for preliminary injunction (Doc. No. 2 ) the significance, if any, of the fact that absentee voting has begun. See Count US IN v. Morales, 172 F.4th 974, 976 (7th Cir. 2026) (granting the State of Indiana's emergency request to stay a preliminary injunction enjoining the enforcement of a state statute that prohibits use of student IDs in elections because "[e]arly voting in Indiana's primary election started without a ruling on the plaintiffs' request for preliminary relief" and "mid-stream relief on what amount to a matter of voter eligibility [is] a clear violation of Purcell"); see also Purcell v. Gonzalez, 549 U.S. 1 (2006). So Ordered by Judge Joseph N. Laplante.(ko)
